X − Y means ‘X is the wife of Y’,

questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be

true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically

follows/follow from the statements.

Statements:

Some shirts are pants.

All pants are jackets.

All jackets are trousers.

Conclusions:

I. Some trousers are shirts.

II. All jackets are shirts.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cf33828f72d0cc33c24a2f0c1b7010bcc4600139e5fbaa86b6f372f3d3ecc4c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some trousers are shirts → Follow (As some shirts are pants, all pants are jackets and all jackets are trousers. As whole pants comes in jackets and whole jacket comes in trousers and some part of pants is common with shirts, therefore it is true.)

II. All jackets are shirts → Does not follow (As some shirts are pants and all pants are jackets. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Select the triad in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the given triads.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent

digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1

and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(11, 1, 10)

(13, 7, 90)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number × 2nd number) - 1 = 3rd number.

Now,

For, (11, 1, 10)

⇒ (11 × 1) - 1

⇒ 11 - 1 = 10.

For, (13, 7, 90)

⇒ (13 × 7) - 1

⇒ 91 - 1 = 90.

Similarly, for **(4, 5, 19)**

**⇒ (4 × 5) - 1 **

**⇒ 20 - 1 = 19.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
